questions.question: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. Using the right and left hand equally well
questions.questionHtml:
Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

Using the right and left hand equally well
questions.solution:
The correct answer is - Ambidextrous.

Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the marked option:
    • Ambidextrous - using both hands with equal ease or dexterity.
  • Here, the prefix 'Ambi' i.e., both reveals the meaning of the given word.
  • Let's look at the meanings of the other given options: 
    • Unskilled - not having or requiring special skill or training.
    • Inexpert - having or showing a lack of skill or knowledge.
    • Left-handed - (of a person) using the left hand more naturally than the right.
  • Hence, from the given meanings, we find that Ambidextrous is the correct one-word substitute.

questions.question: Directions: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. Something which is considered to be very important

Something which is considered to be very important
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Cardinal'. 

Key Points

  • The most appropriate one-word for the given group of words is 'Cardinal'.  
Word Meaning Example
Cardinal of great importance Finding food was a cardinal concern.
Scanty smaller in size or amount than is considered necessary or is hoped for Evidence of such an association is, however, scanty in children of pre-school age.
Meager (of amounts or numbers) very small or not enough The prisoners existed on a meager diet.
Supplementary added to something else in order to improve it or complete it Teachers often create supplementary materials for their classes.

questions.question: Directions: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. A person who is neither well experienced nor professional

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Amateur'. 

Key Points

  • The most appropriate one-word for the given group of words is 'Amateur'. 
Word Meaning Example
Amateur taking part in an activity for pleasure, not as a job He was an amateur singer until the age of 40 when he turned professional.
Proficient skilled and experienced It takes a couple of years of regular driving before you become proficient at it.
Expert a person with a high level of knowledge or skill relating to a particular subject or activity My mother is an expert at dress-making (= she does it very well).
Veteran a person who has had a lot of experience of a particular activity Thousands of veterans will take part in a commemoration of the battle.

A solution or remedy for all difficulties or diseases

  • Hence, from the given meanings, we find that Panacea is the correct one-word substitute.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words. One who investigates and solves crimes
questions.questionHtml:

questions.solution:

questions.question: Directions: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given. A place where a dead person's body is burnt.
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the word which means the same as the group of words given.

A place where a dead person's body is burnt.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'crematorium.'

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Crematorium - A building or place in which the bodies of dead people are burnt. (वह भवन जहाँ शवों को जलाया जाता है; शवदाहगृह)
      • Example: I once visited a crematorium that gave discounts to burn victims.
    • Basement - A room or rooms in a building, partly or completely below ground level. (इमारत के वह कमरे जो अंशतः या पूर्णतः भूमि स्‍तर के नीचे हों; भूमिगत मंज़िल)
      • Example: The canteen is down in the basement.
    • Dungeon - An old underground prison, especially in a castle. (ज़मीन के नीचे बना कै़दख़ाना विशेषतः क़िले में, भूमिगत क़ैदख़ाना)
      • Example: They walked down through an unused part of the dungeon.
    • Graveyard - A burial ground, especially one beside a church. (क़ब्रिस्‍तान)​
      • Example: They made their way to a graveyard to pay their traditional respects to the dead.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 1.

questions.question: Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A quick, sudden movement
questions.questionHtml:
Directions: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A quick, sudden movement
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Flick.'

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Speak - to talk or say things. (कुछ बोलना; कहना)
      • Example: I was so angry I could hardly speak.
    • Fleck - A very small mark on something; a very small piece of something. (किसी वस्‍तु पर बहुत छोटा निशान; किसी वस्‍तु का बहुत छोटा टुकड़ा)
      • Example: The material has a red fleck in it.
    • Dust - Very small pieces of dry dirt, sand, etc. in the form of a powder. (धूल, मिट्टी, गर्द)
      • Example: Everything was covered with a fine layer of dust.
    • Flick - A sudden quick movement. (अचानक तेज़ी के साथ किसी वस्‍तु का हिलना या उसे हिलाना)​
      • Example: The fish gave a quick flick of its tail.
         

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

questions.questionHtml:

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. A large cage, building or enclosure to keep birds
questions.questionHtml:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

A large cage, building or enclosure to keep birds
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- 'Aviary' 
Key Points 

  • Let's look at the meaning of the given options:
  • Aviary: a large cage (area surrounded by wire or bars) or closed space in which birds are kept as pets (एक बड़ा पिंजरा, तार या सलाखों से घिरा क्षेत्र या बंद जगह जिसमें पक्षियों को पालतू जानवरों के रूप में रखा जाता है)
    • Example: The size of my loft for the hens would be 10ft x 8ft, fitted with aviary with inch half battens.
  • Zoo: an area in which animals, especially wild animals, are kept so that people can go and look at them or study them (एक ऐसा क्षेत्र जिसमें जानवरों, विशेषकर जंगली जानवरों को रखा जाता है ताकि लोग जाकर उन्हें देख सकें या उनका अध्ययन कर सकें)
  • Aquarium: a glass container in which fish and other water creatures can be kept (एक कांच का कंटेनर जिसमें मछली और अन्य जल जीव रखे जा सकते हैं)
  • Apiary​​: a place where people keep bees, especially a collection of hives kept to provide honey (वह स्थान जहाँ लोग मधुमक्खियाँ रखते हैं, विशेष रूप से छत्तों का संग्रह जो शहद प्रदान करने के लिए रखा जाता है)

Hence, from the given meanings, we find that Aviary is the correct one-word substitute.

questions.question: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words. Leather straps put around a horse’s head to control it
questions.questionHtml:
Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.

Leather straps put around a horse’s head to control it
questions.solution:
The correct answer is- 'bridle' 
Key Points

  • Let's look at the meaning of the marked option:
  • Bridle: a set of leather straps that are put around a horse's head to allow its rider to control it (चमड़े की पट्टियों का एक सेट जो घोड़े के सिर के चारों ओर लगाया जाता है ताकि उसका सवार उसे नियंत्रित कर सके)
    • Example: Polly saddled and bridled her favourite horse. 
  • Let's look at the meaning of the other given options:
  • Stirrup: one of a pair of pieces of metal shaped like the letter D that hang from the side of a horse's saddle, used for resting your foot when you are riding (अक्षर डी के आकार के धातु के टुकड़ों में से एक जो घोड़े की काठी के किनारे से लटकता है, जब आप सवारी कर रहे होते हैं तो आपके पैर को आराम देने के लिए उपयोग किया जाता है)
  • Bridal: of a woman about to be married, or of a marriage ceremony (एक महिला की शादी होने वाली है, या एक शादी समारोह के बारे में)
  • Saddle: a seat on a bicycle, motorcycle, etc. (साइकिल, मोटरसाइकिल आदि पर बैठने की जगह।)

Hence, from the given meanings, we find that bridle is the correct one-word substitute.

questions.question: Select the option which means the same as the group of words given. One who cannot be reformed or changed
questions.questionHtml:

One who cannot be reformed or changed
questions.solution:
The correct answer is incorrigible.

Key Points

  • Let's see the meanings of the given words-
    • Infallible- .(used about a person) never making mistakes or being wrong (व्‍यक्ति) जो कभी भूलें न करें या ग़लती पर न हो; अमोघ
    • Invincible- too strong or powerful to be defeated इतना सशक्त या बलशाली कि पराजित न किया जा सके; अपराजेय, अजेय
    • Incorrigible- impossible to improve or correct सुधारना या सुधारना असंभव
    • Indelible- that cannot be removed or washed out जो हटाया या धोया न जा सके; अमिट, अलोप्‍य, स्‍थायी
  • Hence, according to the meanings of the given words, the correct answer is Option 3 i.e. Incorrigible.

questions.questionHtml:

    • Communal- shared by a group of people सामूहिक, सामुदायिक, पंचायती
  • Hence, the correct answer is Option 3 i.e. Hypocrite.

questions.question: Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words. Instrument that measures the altitude of the land surface
questions.questionHtml:

questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Altimeter'.

Key Points

  • The most appropriate word for the given group of words is 'Altimeter'.
  • Altimeter: An instrument for showing height above sea level, used especially in an aircraft समुद्र तल से ऊँचाई मापने का यंत्र; तुंगतामापी; एल्टिमीटर

Correct Answer: Altimeter.

Additional Information

    • arboreal: living in trees. (वृक्ष-संबंधी; पेड़ों में रहना)
    • mammal: a warm-blooded vertebrate animal of a class that is distinguished by the possession of hair or fur, females that secrete milk for the nourishment of the young, and (typically) the birth of live young. (एक वर्ग का एक गर्म-खून वाला कशेरुकी जानवर जो बालों या फर के कब्जे से अलग होता है, मादाएं जो युवा के पोषण के लिए दूध का स्राव करती हैं, और (आमतौर पर) जीवित युवाओं का जन्म)
    • vertebrate: an animal of a large group distinguished by the possession of a backbone or spinal column, including mammals, birds, reptiles, amphibians, and fishes. (पृष्ठवंशी या कशेरुकी या कशेरुकदंडी प्राणिसाम्राज्य के कॉरडेटा (Chordata) समुदाय का सबसे बड़ा उपसमुदाय है। जिसके सदस्यों में रीढ़ की हड्डियाँ (backbones) या पृष्ठवंश विद्यमान रहते हैं)

A person authorised to examine and verify accounts
